fusions.name: Rattling Plates
fusions.desc: Rattles a ring of stiffened strands around you, dealing 4 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Rolled Barb
fusions.desc: Rolls your strands into a ball and slams it into a target, dealing 14 blunt damage, leaving it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Overlap Shell
fusions.desc: Layers your strands into a shell that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lapped Tiers
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
